title: r1 blocker fix (personal-statement threading) shipped with zero regression pins — re-dropping the statements fails no test
evidence:
Fix commit 1efcf27 (3f7e09f..1efcf27) adds, with no test-file change (stat: 'server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam | 7 +', 'server/src/demo/pdf_report_data.gleam | 18 +-', '10 files changed' — 8 are PDFs):
280:  statement statement: String,
323:    personal_statement: Some(statement),
grep 'personal_statement' across client/test + server/test hits only real-app tests (client_test.gleam:2492 view test, server/test/integration/*, server/test/ai/audit_report_test.gleam:142) — nothing in server/test/demo or client/test/demo reads payload rows.
detail: The exact r1 B1 blocker regression re-ships silently: drop the statement param, re-bake, suite stays green. Only manual pdftotext catches it. P0-class behaviour, zero automated coverage.
recommended_fix: Add a pin iterating pdf_prebake.payloads() asserting every row.personal_statement is Some() and matches the client fixture text; consuming payloads() also closes N5.

title: N8 still present since round 1: committed demo PDFs have no freshness pin against prebake output — a stale bake ships silently
evidence: grep 'pdftotext|sha256|manifest' across server/test, scripts/*.py, Makefile → only unrelated hits (server/test/meta/meta_client_test.gleam:85 'pub fn hash_email_is_sha256_hex_lowercase_test()'; scripts/lint_demo_network_bite_test.py manifest is the network lint's fn-manifest). Nothing ties committed PDF bytes to current payload code; the r1 fix required a manual re-bake.
detail: The r1 blocker fix itself needed a re-bake; without a freshness signal the next payload edit ships stale PDFs with a green suite.
recommended_fix: Have the bake emit a sha256 manifest per PDF and assert the committed files match it in the server suite.

title: N2 still present since round 1: banner-survival pin is one-sided — consent banner's own z-index/anchor unasserted
evidence:
demo_flow_test.gleam:1076: '  |> string.contains("fixed top-20 right-4 z-[2147483001]")' — toast side only. consent.js:391-393: '  var bannerCss =

title: N3 still present since round 1: docs_processed pin is param-echo — it feeds documents_for's length in and asserts the same expression back
evidence: server/test/demo/pdf_report_data_test.gleam:108: '  let docs = list.length(pdf_prebake.documents_for(app_id))' fed to pdf_report_data.extras_for(app_id, docs); :161: '    |> should.equal(list.length(pdf_prebake.documents_for(app_id)))'. The real bake wiring (to_report_data) and server↔client document-list parity are not covered by this equality.
detail: Asserting a field computed from the identical input pins only the JSON encoder; document-list drift between screen and PDF would pass.
recommended_fix: Pin per-applicant document counts/categories in extras against the client fixture document lists (demo_store.documents_for).

title: N5 still present since round 1: pub widenings with no external callers (pdf_prebake.payloads, demo_store.competition_ranks)

detail: Dead public surface invites drift; the demo tests call leaderboard() end-to-end instead of the pub rank helper.
recommended_fix: Consume payloads() in the statement-parity pin (finding above) and competition_ranks in mirrored rank tests, or revert both to fn.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: P0 100% (3/3 round deliverables pinned: toast demo-path render, extras section depth for all 8 applicants, compare-top-3 gate inputs + render proof). P1 ≈17%: personal-statement parity 0%, flags/positives sync 0%, rank tie/None-tail semantics ~50% (distinct-score happy path only). Overall ≈35% (phone/tenure rows, fallback, PDF freshness, click-through, docs wiring all 0–50%). P1 <80% and overall <80% → FAIL.
recommended_fix: Three pins flip the gate: payloads()-based statement/flags parity test, mirrored tie/None rank tests + v-harbour leaderboard, and a bake-freshness sha256 manifest. That lifts P1 to ~100%, overall >80%.
